comment: Inputs of the R1-BX-D14 recompute (g4_tasl.py dates) for the G.5 table on the TASL pair: one concurrent worker slot (TASL-2's RTX 4090; TASL-7's serves the proposer), the seven passed census nodes (mlgym_houseprice joins under R1-TRACKG-G3-EARLY, its U2 passed in the U4 census; CPU-only, counted in the same slot-hours), census run times on the RTX 6000 Ada scaled by the measured 4090/census ratio. Other inputs as sweep2/g4/g4_dates_params.json; assumptions to confirm.
concurrent_slots_note: the key name is g4_lib's; on the TASL pair it counts RTX 4090 worker slots
queue_days_note: direct host runs: no scheduler queue
